explicit-cost.def: An explicit cost is a money payment for a resource, such as rent or wages paid; an implicit cost is the value of a resource the decision maker already owns or gives up, such as her own time, with no payment made.

total-benefit.def: Everything a choice gives the decision maker: satisfaction for a consumer, revenue for a firm. Net benefit is total benefit minus total cost.

total-cost.def: Total cost: everything a choice costs, its explicit costs (money paid out) and its implicit costs (the value of the next best alternative given up). A choice is worth making when total benefit exceeds total cost.
